results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An article highlighting a study by sociologist and professor Fabio Giglietto from the University of Urbino. The coverage details how Meta's algorithmic policies for reducing political content systematically restricted the visibility of elected representatives while leaving extremist networks highly visible, sparking significant concern and investigations at the European Commission level.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: This report discusses the widespread political and public debate following a broadcast by the investigative TV program 'Report' (Rai3). It cites the findings of Professor Fabio Giglietto's study, 'A Pretty Blunt Approach,' which demonstrated a massive 72% reduction in social media visibility for Italian parliamentarians due to Meta's algorithms. The article notes that his research directly prompted European Parliament inquiries and hearings with the Italian communications authority Agcom.
